title: Maria's Food Blog
text:
Maria writes a food blog about her city. Every week, she visits a new cafe and tries the cakes. Her blog has photos of the drinks and the food. Many people read it before they go out.

Last Friday, Maria wrote about a small bakery near the station. The bread was warm and the owner was very friendly. Maria said the prices were low, so students can afford it. Her readers left many nice comments.

questions.text: How often does Maria visit a new cafe?
Where is the bakery that Maria wrote about?
What can we infer about Maria's readers?
options: They often plan visits based on her blog

questions.text: Why might students like the bakery?

paragraph_translations: Maria escribe un blog de comida sobre su ciudad. Cada semana visita una cafetería nueva y prueba los pasteles. Su blog tiene fotos de las bebidas y de la comida. Muchas personas lo leen antes de salir.

El viernes pasado, Maria escribió sobre una panadería pequeña cerca de la estación. El pan estaba caliente y el dueño era muy amable. Maria dijo que los precios eran bajos, así que los estudiantes pueden pagarla. Sus lectores dejaron muchos comentarios agradables.
